description: Deep plum-purple floor-length fitted gown with low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and gold woven vine/geometric trim on neckline, bodice seams, cuffs and skirt front. Cream linen shoulder wrap with purple-and-gold bordered edges rests around the forearms. Decorated belt with round gold-coloured buckle and fittings; small round shoulder brooches, dangling gold earrings and a ring. Brown-gold leather shoe visible through low front walking opening; other foot lies under skirt. Both hands visible clasped in front. No headgear, armor or weapon.
